literature_references.title: MEXMA: Token-level objectives improve sentence representations
literature_references.relevance: Supports cross-lingual sentence encoder approaches to improve representation quality across tasks, essential for C3.

literature_references.title: LACA: Improving Cross-lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with LLM Data Augmentation
literature_references.relevance: Directly addresses the bilingual ESG coverage gap (G1) by generating high-quality pseudo-labeled data in target languages without translation tools.

literature_references.title: Multi-level Association Refinement Network for Dialogue Aspect-based Sentiment Quadruple Analysis
literature_references.relevance: Provides methods for precise handling of associations at utterance and word levels, supporting the fine-grained ABSA goal of C1.

literature_references.title: Auto-Arena: Automating LLM Evaluations with Agent Peer Battles and Committee Discussions
literature_references.relevance: Foundational for C8; provides an innovative framework for automating evaluation using LLM-powered agents to reduce bias.

literature_references.title: SkillAggregation: Reference-free LLM-Dependent Aggregation
literature_references.relevance: Supports C10 (Fusion) by proposing methods to combine estimates from multiple LLM judges without ground truth data.

literature_references.title: LLM×MapReduce: Simplified Long-Sequence Processing using Large Language Models
literature_references.relevance: Directly supports C13 and P4 by using a divide-and-conquer strategy to process long texts without training.

literature_references.title: NeuSym-RAG: Hybrid Neural Symbolic Retrieval with Multiview Structuring for PDF Question Answering
literature_references.relevance: Validates C7 and C15; proposes a hybrid framework combining neural and symbolic retrieval for structured content like PDFs.

literature_references.title: Deliberate Reasoning in Language Models as Structure-Aware Planning with an Accurate World Model
literature_references.relevance: Aligns with C7; uses entailment graphs to encode structured dependencies and enable symbolic verification.

literature_references.title: Improving Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Quasi-Symbolic Abstractions
literature_references.relevance: Provides the 'Quasi-Symbolic Abstract Reasoning' (QuaSAR) framework to disentangle content from logical reasoning, supporting C15.

research_questions: RQ4.5: Tone–outcome mismatch as greenwashing indicator

literature_references.title: Language Models can Subtly Deceive Without Lying: A Case Study on Strategic Phrasing in Legislation
literature_references.relevance: Provides the 'Lobbyist' testbed for analyzing subtle deception through phrasing, highly relevant to C11 (Greenwashing detection).

literature_references.title: Pattern Recognition or Medical Knowledge? The Problem with Multiple-Choice Questions in Medicine
literature_references.relevance: Supports the need for G3 and P3 by highlighting how pattern recognition can overestimate true clinical/contextual understanding.

literature_references.title: A Theory of Response Sampling in LLMs: Part Descriptive and Part Prescriptive
literature_references.relevance: Theoretically supports C14 by exploring how prescriptive norms (ideals) in LLMs result in biased decision-making.

literature_references.title: Controllable and Reliable Knowledge-Intensive Task-Oriented Conversational Agents with Declarative Genie Worksheets
literature_references.relevance: Provides a programmable framework (Genie) for reliable, grounded responses, supporting the 'auditable pipeline' goal of C12.

literature_references.title: RAGEval: Scenario Specific RAG Evaluation Dataset Generation Framework
literature_references.relevance: Supports O5 by introducing novel metrics (Completeness, Hallucination, Irrelevance) to rigorously evaluate RAG responses.
